messages:
lina: FYI customer acme-inc is hitting 403s when calls from their Private VPC try to wrap/unwrap keys via our KMS proxy. Started ~09:12 PST, affecting /v1/encrypt endpoints and audit logs are missing. Escalating to eng-security + oncall. ops-bot: INC-8523 created

raj: Can you drop the minimal repro and packet capture? Are they using NAT or VPC endpoints?

lina: Repro steps from customer:
1) curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -X POST https://kms.private.redwood/api/v1/wrap -d '{"keyId":"...","plaintext":"..."}'
2) gets 403 with body: {"error":"access_denied","code":403}

sam: Any firewall / egress rules blocking 443 to kms.redwood-internal? If their NAT isn't allowing SNI or ALPN, our proxy -> HSM handshake might fail.

lina: They run strict deny outbound, only allow a few FQDNs. Their firewall logs show ACCEPT to 10.4.1.1:443 but our audit logs show no incoming request. Suspect egress proxy interception rewriting SNI.

security-oncall: Assigning to HSM team and network. Need tcpdump from proxy + client side, and our edge logs (x-forwarded-for). Also we need Cloud NAT conntrack counts.

raj: Quick check: can you run this from their shell and paste output?

```
curl -v --resolve kms.private.redwood:443:10.4.1.1 https://kms.private.redwood/v1/status
```

lina: They ran it, got SSL handshake error: "tls: handshake failure". Attached tcpdump snippet shows TLS ClientHello but server doesn't reply. :eyes: 

sam: That suggests MITM proxy or firewall terminating TLS and not forwarding SNI. Workaround: allow raw passthrough to kms endpoints or permit destination IP range. For longer term we should document required egress FQDNs + SNI passthrough in Private VPC guide.

security-oncall: Also confirm KMS key policy: if requests hit proxy with no auth header we return 403 and don't log payloads by design. That explains missing audit entries.

lina: Customer reports sudden billing spike correlated with retries. Need to add a mitigation to rate-limit on client side and revert backoff.

ops-bot: INC-8523 updated: severity=high, assigned_to=raj, slas=4h

raj: Plan: 1) get tcpdump + curl output (by 10:00) 2) add temporary firewall rule to allow direct egress to kms ip range (if customer approves) 3) HSM team to validate proxy config (by 14:00). I'll own coordination.

lina: I'll get captures and customer approval now. will ping here when uploaded. :thumbsup: 

security-oncall: FYI HSM lead @marco please weigh in on whether proxy should emit audit event for unauthenticated attempts.

marco: quick note — proxy intentionally drops unauthenticated attempts pre-auth for security, but we can add minimal audit stub (metadata only) to help triage.

lina: Uploaded pcaps to secure share: https://redwood.share/pcap/INC-8523

raj: Received. Beginning analysis.

security-oncall: Keep updates short here. If we escalate to customer-facing incident, loop in support and legal.

lina: Thanks team.
